title: Assistant Sales Manager
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION
E-Commerce Sales Manager
 Company: Talenteq Technology India Pvt. Ltd.
 Location: Surajpur Industrial Area, Greater Noida, Uttar Pradesh
 Department: Sales 
 Designation: E-Commerce Sales Manager
 Experience: 58 Years
 Industry Preference: LED Lighting / Electrical / Electronics / Solar / Consumer Durables / E-Commerce
 Employment Type: Full-Time
Job Summary
We are looking for an experienced and result-oriented E-Commerce Sales Manager to manage and grow our online sales business across major e-commerce marketplaces and digital channels.
The candidate will be responsible for developing e-commerce sales strategies, managing online marketplaces, improving product visibility, driving revenue, monitoring sales performance, and coordinating with internal teams for smooth order fulfillment.
The ideal candidate should have strong experience in LED lighting, electrical products, electronics, solar products, consumer durables, or similar product categories and a good understanding of platforms such as Amazon, Flipkart, IndiaMART and other B2B/B2C marketplaces.
Key Responsibilities
 Develop and execute strategies to achieve e-commerce sales and revenue targets . Manage company presence and sales on Amazon, Flipkart, IndiaMART and other relevant marketplaces . Handle complete online product lifecycle including: Product listing and catalog creation
 Product descriptions and specifications
 Product images and content
 Pricing and promotional activities
 Inventory availability
 Order processing and fulfillment
 Monitor daily, weekly and monthly sales performance, revenue, orders, conversion rates and marketplace KPIs . Identify opportunities to increase product visibility, traffic and online sales. Plan and execute marketplace promotions, discounts, campaigns and advertisements . Monitor competitor pricing, products, reviews, offers and market trends. Coordinate with the Marketing, Warehouse, Production, Purchase and Accounts teams to ensure smooth order processing and timely delivery. Ensure accurate inventory and prevent stock-out and overstock situations . Analyze customer reviews, ratings and feedback and coordinate with relevant teams for improvement. Handle marketplace-related issues, claims, returns, cancellations and customer escalations. Prepare regular MIS reports and sales analysis for management. Track marketplace expenses, advertising spend and overall profitability. Develop strategies for improving ROAS, conversion rate and marketplace profitability . Explore new online sales channels and business opportunities. Lead and guide the e-commerce sales team, if applicable. Required Skills
Strong knowledge of E-Commerce Sales & Marketplace Management.
 Hands-on experience with Amazon Seller Central / Flipkart Seller Hub / IndiaMART or similar platforms .
 Good understanding of B2B and B2C online sales .
 Experience in managing product catalogs and online listings.
 Strong knowledge of digital marketing, marketplace advertising and promotions .
 Excellent analytical and reporting skills.
 Good knowledge of MS Excel including Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, MIS and sales analysis.
 Strong negotiation, communication and coordination skills.
 Ability to analyze competitors and market trends.
 Target-oriented approach with strong business and commercial understanding.
 
Preferred Industry Experience
 Candidates from the following industries will be preferred:
 LED Lighting
 Electrical & Electronics
 Solar Products
 Consumer Electronics
 Electrical Accessories
 Home Appliances
 Consumer Durables
 Hardware / Building Products
 E-Commerce / Marketplace Business
Qualification
 Graduate in any discipline.
 MBA/PGDM in Marketing, Sales or E-Commerce will be an added advantage.
Experience
 58 years of relevant experience , preferably in E-Commerce Sales / Marketplace Management.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
 Monthly E-Commerce Revenue
 Order Volume & Sales Growth
 Marketplace Conversion Rate
 Product Ranking & Visibility
 Advertising ROI / ROAS
 Marketplace Profitability
 Inventory Availability
 Return & Cancellation Rate
 Customer Rating & Reviews
 New Marketplace/Channel Development
Candidate Profile
The ideal candidate should be a hands-on E-Commerce professional who can independently manage online marketplaces, develop sales strategies, analyze business data and deliver measurable revenue growth.
Candidates with proven experience in LED lights, indoor/outdoor lighting, solar lighting or electrical products will be highly preferred.
Salary
 As per industry standards and candidate's experience/skill set.

title: Head Enterprise Sales
description:
Position Overview Elitecon International Limited is looking for an experienced business leader to develop its enterprise accounts, government and institutional business, and export sales. The role will be responsible for profitable growth, new customer acquisition and long-term commercial relationships across these channels. The position requires a strong background in FMCG or manufacturing-led businesses, with hands-on experience in large-account sales, government tendering and international market development. The candidate should be able to convert opportunities into executable contracts while maintaining discipline on pricing, payment terms and collections. Working closely with Finance, Legal, Compliance, Production and Supply Chain, the Head will lead domestic and international sales execution, customer commitments and channel-specific business plans. Key Responsibilities Business Strategy and Revenue Ownership Prepare annual business plans and revenue, margin and collection targets for enterprise, government and export channels. Identify priority accounts, eligible institutional opportunities and export markets suited to the product portfolio. Allocate resources across channels based on commercial potential, execution capacity and risk. Build a balanced customer base and monitor dependence on individual buyers, tenders or countries. Enterprise Sales and Key Accounts Acquire large corporate and institutional customers through structured prospecting, vendor registration and account development. Build relationships with procurement teams, business heads and key decision-makers. Lead customer presentations, product trials, commercial proposals and negotiations. Develop account plans covering repeat orders, additional product categories and contract renewals. Own major account escalations and coordinate timely resolution of delivery, quality and billing concerns. Government Business Development Identify relevant opportunities with government departments, public sector organisations and institutional buyers, subject to product and procurement eligibility. Oversee vendor empanelment and registrations on relevant procurement platforms, including GeM where applicable. Track tender notices, qualification requirements, bid deadlines and procurement plans. Build professional relationships with procurement stakeholders through authorised and transparent engagement. Develop business only where the Company can meet the stated specifications, eligibility conditions and supply commitments. Tendering and Contract Execution Lead bid or no-bid reviews based on eligibility, expected margins, working capital, delivery obligations and contract risks. Coordinate technical and commercial submissions with the relevant internal teams and maintain complete supporting records. Work with Finance on bid securities, performance guarantees and associated expiry or release tracking, where required. Obtain approval for pricing and contractual exceptions before submission or acceptance. Track awarded contracts through supply, inspection, acceptance, invoicing and payment; escalate delays and potential penalties early. Export Market Development Identify and develop overseas importers, distributors, institutional buyers and strategic partners. Assess market potential, competition, channel economics and buyer credibility before committing resources. Lead distributor selection and negotiate territory coverage, targets, payment arrangements and renewal conditions. Develop market-entry plans with clear sales milestones, required approvals and launch budgets. Represent the Company at relevant trade exhibitions, buyer meetings and export promotion forums. Export Commercials and Operations Prepare export proposals with Finance and Logistics, considering freight, insurance, currency exposure and agreed delivery terms. Negotiate payment security and commercial terms within approved limits, including letters of credit or advance payments where suitable. Coordinate orders, production schedules, packaging requirements, shipping documentation and dispatch with the responsible teams. Obtain confirmation from Legal, Compliance and relevant specialists on destination-market requirements before accepting orders. Track shipment status, customer acceptance, claims and export receivables through to closure. Pricing and Commercial Governance Protect account and channel profitability through disciplined pricing, discounts and service commitments. Review supply and distribution agreements with Legal and Finance before signing through authorised signatories. Ensure credit periods, exclusivity and other special terms receive the required internal approvals. Maintain transparent records of commissions, intermediaries and customer-related expenditure. Follow Company ethics requirements and ensure that no improper payments or commitments are made to secure business. Collections and Risk Management Own customer collection follow-up in coordination with Finance and monitor overdue receivables by channel. Resolve invoice disputes, deductions and documentation gaps that delay payments. Support credit checks and monitor approved limits before further supplies. Flag buyer, country, currency and contract risks promptly and agree mitigation with the relevant teams. Coordinate counterparty screening and applicable trade-restriction checks with Compliance before onboarding and shipment. Cross Functional Coordination and Reporting Provide realistic demand forecasts to Production and Supply Chain and confirm capacity before making delivery commitments. Share customer and market feedback with Marketing and Product Development. Maintain accurate CRM records of opportunities, bids, contracts, orders and collections. Report channel-wise revenue, margins, pipeline, bid outcomes, export performance and receivable ageing to management. Review forecast variances and implement clear corrective actions with named owners and timelines. Team Leadership Build and develop enterprise sales, government business and export teams with clear account and territory ownership. Set measurable targets and review both commercial results and collection performance. Coach teams on negotiation, tender discipline, international account management and customer service. Strengthen coordination between sales teams and the functions responsible for contract execution. Candidate Profile Preferably 15-20 years of progressive sales and business development experience, including significant leadership responsibility. Strong experience in FMCG, consumer products or manufacturing-led businesses. Demonstrated exposure across enterprise sales, government or institutional business, and exports. Proven success in acquiring large accounts, winning commercially sound business and developing overseas buyers or distributors. Hands-on understanding of tender evaluation, bid preparation, vendor empanelment and government contract execution. Experience with GeM and relevant e-procurement platforms, where applicable to the product portfolio. Sound understanding of export pricing, international delivery terms, payment instruments, shipping coordination and distributor management. Strong commercial judgment on pricing, margins, credit exposure and working-capital requirements. Ability to manage senior customer relationships and coordinate effectively with Finance, Legal, Production and Logistics. Strong negotiation, presentation, forecasting and team-management skills. Bachelors degree required; an MBA or postgraduate qualification in Sales, Marketing, International Business or a related field is preferred. Willingness to travel within India and internationally as business requires. Key Success Factors Achievement of channel-wise revenue, margin and collection targets. Acquisition and retention of profitable enterprise and institutional accounts. A qualified tender pipeline and successful execution of awarded contracts. Growth in export revenue, repeat orders and productive overseas partnerships. Timely payments and controlled overdue receivables. Reliable customer deliveries and resolution of commercial issues. Accurate forecasts and disciplined approvals, documentation and ethical business conduct. Preferred Candidate Background A senior sales leader from FMCG, consumer products or manufacturing with experience across large enterprise accounts, government procurement and international business development, supported by strong commercial negotiation and collection discipline.

title: Business Development Executive- vessel chartering
description:
Role & responsibilities Key Responsibilities 1. Business Development Identify and develop new customers for vessel chartering and freight services. Generate business from cargo owners, traders, manufacturers, exporters, importers and logistics companies. Develop relationships with companies requiring regular coastal and international cargo movement. Identify cargo volumes, origins, destinations and shipping requirements. Develop new accounts and maintain long-term relationships with existing customers. Prepare and maintain a pipeline of potential cargo and chartering opportunities. Meet customers regularly to understand their logistics and transportation requirements. 2. Vessel Chartering Develop and coordinate opportunities for: Time charter Voyage charter Contract of Affreightment (COA) Spot cargo movements Coastal vessel requirements Bulk cargo transportation Project cargo movement Break-bulk cargo Containerised cargo, where applicable The candidate should understand the commercial aspects of vessel chartering, including: Vessel size and type Cargo compatibility Loading/discharging ports Laycan Freight rates Charter-party terms Demurrage/despatch Laytime Port restrictions Draft limitations Bunker considerations Deadweight capacity Vessel positioning Voyage economics 3. Coastal Shipping Business Develop business opportunities for movement of cargo along the Indian coast and, where applicable, through inland/coastal routes. Potential cargo categories may include: Coal Iron ore Steel Cement Clinker Fertiliser Grain Minerals Aggregates Project cargo Industrial raw materials General/break-bulk cargo Containers Coordinate with customers and operations teams to understand: Origin port Destination port Cargo quantity Loading rate Discharge rate Required vessel size Shipment frequency Laycan Port restrictions Draft limitations Required delivery schedule 4. Ocean Freight Business Develop new business for international sea freight and ocean transportation. Responsibilities may include: Identifying import/export cargo opportunities. Developing relationships with exporters and importers. Understanding FCL/LCL and bulk shipment requirements. Obtaining and comparing freight offers. Coordinating with shipping lines, vessel owners, NVOCCs and freight forwarders. Supporting negotiation of ocean freight rates. Tracking market movements and freight-rate trends. Developing regular and project-based ocean freight business. 5. Cargo Sourcing Build a strong network of cargo owners and traders. The candidate should actively identify: Regular cargo contracts Spot cargoes Seasonal cargo Import/export cargo Coastal cargo Backhaul opportunities Project cargo Large-volume commodity movements Maintain an updated database of: Cargo Owner Commodity Quantity Origin Destination Shipment Frequency Required Vessel Expected Freight Potential Margin 6. Vessel Sourcing & Market Intelligence Work closely with the chartering/operations team to identify suitable vessels for customer requirements. Monitor: Vessel availability Open positions Freight market Bunker prices Port congestion Seasonal demand Vessel supply Charter rates Coastal freight rates International freight rates Competitor activity Maintain relationships with: Ship owners Ship operators Charterers Ship brokers Agents Freight forwarders NVOCCs Port operators 7. Commercial Negotiation Support negotiation of: Freight rates Charter rates Voyage terms Laytime Demurrage/despatch Payment terms Loading/discharge conditions Port costs Bunker-related costs Other commercial terms Coordinate with management, legal and operations teams before finalising contractual commitments. 8. Customer Relationship Management Develop long-term relationships with: Large industrial companies Commodity traders Importers Exporters Manufacturers Infrastructure companies Mining companies Steel companies Cement companies Power companies Fertiliser companies Shipping companies Freight forwarders Logistics companies Regularly visit customers and understand their upcoming cargo programmes. 9. Tender & Contract Business Identify and participate in relevant: Shipping tenders Coastal movement tenders Freight contracts Annual transportation contracts COA opportunities Project cargo contracts Government/PSU cargo movement opportunities Coordinate preparation of commercial quotations, technical information and tender documentation. 10. Profitability & Commercial Analysis Before submitting major quotations, evaluate: Expected revenue Vessel cost Port costs Bunker cost Agency costs Cargo handling costs Canal/other voyage costs, where applicable Demurrage exposure Operational risks Credit/payment terms Expected gross margin Work with the finance and operations teams to ensure that business is commercially viable. 
 Preferred candidate profile 
 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Performance will be measured through: New customers acquired New cargo contracts secured Chartering opportunities generated Annual cargo volume secured Tonnes moved TEUs handled, where applicable Revenue generated Gross margin Number/value of COAs secured Coastal shipping business developed Ocean freight business developed Vessel utilisation/business opportunities generated Customer retention Sales pipeline value Repeat business Collection/credit discipline Candidate Profile Educational Qualification Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Commerce, Logistics, Maritime Studies, Shipping, Economics or related discipline. MBA/PGDM in Marketing, Logistics, Shipping or Supply Chain Management will be an advantage. A qualification in Maritime/Shipping studies will be preferred. Experience 38 years of relevant experience in one or more of: Vessel chartering Ship broking Coastal shipping Ocean freight Shipping agency Maritime logistics Freight forwarding Bulk cargo transportation Project cargo Commodity logistics Chartering desk Commercial shipping Candidates with strong customer and cargo relationships will be preferred. Technical & Commercial Knowledge The candidate should have practical knowledge of: Vessel types and capacities Dry bulk / break-bulk / container shipping DWT and vessel specifications Port operations Laycan Laytime Demurrage Despatch Voyage estimation Freight calculation Charter-party basics Cargo documentation Bills of Lading Shipping instructions Port charges Bunker economics Vessel positioning Shipping routes Coastal movement Ocean freight markets Knowledge of GENCON, NYPE, ASBATANKVOY and other commonly used charter-party forms will be an advantage, depending on the cargo and vessel segment. Core Competencies Strong commercial understanding Excellent negotiation skills Customer acquisition Cargo sourcing Vessel sourcing Relationship management Market intelligence Freight-rate analysis Commercial proposal preparation Contract understanding Strong communication skills Good numerical/financial ability Problem-solving Strong follow-up Ability to work under time pressure Network Requirement The ideal candidate should have an established or developable network among: Cargo owners Commodity traders Shipping companies Ship owners Ship brokers Charterers Freight forwarders NVOCCs Port agents Logistics companies Industrial customers A demonstrable ability to originate cargo and convert relationships into shipping contracts will be highly valued. 
 Perks and benefits 
 A performance-linked incentive/commission structure may be provided based on: New business generated Cargo volume Revenue Gross margin New contracts Customer retention

Job Description Industrial Magnet Sales Executive 
 Position: Industrial Magnet Sales Executive / B2B Sales Executive
 Experience: Fresher / 01 Year
 Qualification: Graduate with Chemistry background
 Employment Type: Full-Time
 Location: Noida, Sector 63
 Travel: Willingness to travel across India as required
 About the Role 
We are looking for a motivated and technically interested Industrial Magnet Sales Executive to join our B2B sales team.
The candidate will be responsible for identifying industrial customers, connecting with decision-makers, scheduling appointments, visiting customers, understanding their magnet requirements, and developing business opportunities.
Our products include Rare Earth Magnets, Permanent Magnets, and Neodymium (NdFeB) Magnets used in various industrial applications, including motors, EV motors, BLDC motors, automation, pumps and other manufacturing applications.
A Chemistry background is required because the candidate should be able to understand basic material and magnet-related specifications and communicate effectively with customers.
 Key Responsibilities 
 Identify and research potential B2B industrial customers across India. Generate leads through online research, databases, references, cold calling and other sources. Contact companies and decision-makers to understand their requirements. Schedule appointments before visiting customers . Visit industrial customers and manufacturing units for business development. Understand the customer's product, motor/application and magnet requirement. Identify whether the customer is using NdFeB, ferrite or other permanent magnets . Collect technical requirements such as magnet type, grade, size, shape, coating, tolerance and application. Coordinate with the technical/internal team for drawings, samples, specifications and quotations. Follow up with customers from initial enquiry to quotation, sample approval and order. Maintain accurate records of leads, customer meetings, requirements, quotations and follow-ups. Develop long-term relationships with Purchase, Procurement, R&D, Motor Design and management teams. Achieve assigned sales and lead-generation targets. Travel to different cities and states across India for customer meetings when required. Target Customers / Industries 
The candidate will primarily target manufacturers and companies using magnets in their products, including:
 EV manufacturers and EV motor manufacturers Electric 2-wheeler and 3-wheeler manufacturers EV component and e-axle manufacturers Industrial motor manufacturers BLDC, PMSM and servo motor manufacturers DC motor manufacturers Fan and BLDC fan manufacturers Pump and compressor manufacturers Automation and robotics companies Wind-energy equipment manufacturers Elevator and traction-machine manufacturers Automotive component manufacturers Electronics and sensor manufacturers The sales guide highlights EV/automotive, BLDC fans, industrial motors, wind, elevators, solar pumps, robotics/automation and pumps as key target sectors.
 What the Candidate Needs to Understand 
The candidate does not need extensive prior magnet-sales experience. However, they should be willing to learn about:
 Permanent magnets Rare Earth Magnets Neodymium (NdFeB) Magnets Ferrite Magnets Basic magnet grades and specifications Magnet dimensions, shape and coating Motor applications EV and DC/BLDC/PMSM motor applications Industrial B2B sales processes For example, NdFeB magnets are used in EV motors, industrial motors, robotics, automation, speakers and sensors.
 Candidate Profile 
 Graduate with Chemistry background is mandatory. Freshers are welcome. Strong interest in building a career in B2B/industrial sales . Good communication and interpersonal skills. Confident in speaking with company owners, purchase managers and technical teams. Comfortable making cold calls and following up with customers. Willing to visit factories and industrial areas. Willing to travel anywhere in India for customer meetings. Good basic understanding of Chemistry/materials is preferred. Must be willing to learn technical product specifications. Basic knowledge of MS Excel, email and CRM/lead management is preferred. Having a two-wheeler and a valid driving licence would be an advantage. Sales Process 
The candidate will generally follow this process:
 Lead Generation Customer Calling Requirement Identification Appointment Customer Visit Technical Requirement Collection Quotation Follow-up Sample/Approval Order 
The candidate should focus on understanding the customer's actual application and requirements rather than simply asking whether they need magnets.
 Key Performance Indicators 
Performance will be evaluated based on:
 Number of qualified B2B leads generated Number of customer calls Appointments scheduled Customer visits completed New customer accounts developed Quotations generated Follow-ups and conversion Sales revenue generated Customer relationship development Accuracy of customer/technical information collected Important Requirement 
 This is a field-oriented B2B industrial sales role. Candidates must be comfortable with customer visits and travelling across India. 
The candidate should have the ability to communicate with both commercial and technical contacts , including Purchase Managers, Procurement teams, R&D/Motor Design teams and business owners.

description:
Sales Executive Company: Uvento Genix Pvt. Ltd.
 Department: Sales & Marketing
 Job Type: Full-Time
 Experience: 03 Years
 Qualification: Diploma / Graduate – Mechanical or Electrical Engineering About Uvento Genix At Uvento Genix Pvt. Ltd. , we believe in providing solutions, not just products . We work with manufacturing industries to understand their operational challenges and provide the right technical solutions to improve productivity, safety, quality, and efficiency. We are looking for an enthusiastic and driven Sales Executive who is keen to build a career in B2B industrial sales and technical solution selling . The Role As a Sales Executive, you will be responsible for developing new business, managing existing customers, understanding customer requirements, and coordinating with our engineering and principal partners to deliver the right solution. This role involves a combination of lead generation, customer visits, technical discussions, sales, order coordination, and relationship management . Key Responsibilities Generate new business opportunities through cold calling, references, digital/marketing leads, and customer visits . Visit manufacturing plants and meet plant heads, purchase teams, maintenance teams, production teams, and decision-makers . Understand customer requirements and identify suitable products/solutions. Prepare and follow up on quotations, proposals, and commercial offers . Convert qualified leads into orders and consistently work towards achieving sales targets. Develop and maintain strong, long-term relationships with existing customers. Coordinate with the engineering team and principals for technical requirements, product selection, and solution development. Manage the complete order cycle — from Purchase Order (P.O.) to delivery, installation, commissioning, and customer satisfaction . Coordinate internally and with principals for order processing, dispatch, installation, and commissioning. Maintain regular follow-ups with prospects and customers. Keep customer and sales information updated in the company's records/CRM. Continuously learn about industrial products, applications, competitors, and market opportunities. What We Are Looking For Diploma or Graduate in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering . 0–3 years of experience in sales, marketing, industrial sales, or a related field. Prior sales experience is an advantage but not mandatory . Basic knowledge of MS Office, Excel, email, and internet applications . Good communication and interpersonal skills. Willingness to travel for customer meetings and site visits . A positive, confident, and enthusiastic approach towards customers. Strong follow-up and relationship-building skills. Ability to understand customer problems and communicate solutions effectively. Most importantly, someone who is genuinely interested in learning sales, marketing, industrial applications, and business development . Who Will Be a Good Fit? This role is ideal for someone who: Enjoys meeting and talking to people. Is comfortable making calls and visiting industrial customers. Is curious about how machines, manufacturing processes, and industrial solutions work. Wants to learn consultative and solution-based selling rather than simply selling products. Is motivated by targets and business growth. Is willing to take ownership and learn through experience. Freshers with the right attitude and willingness to learn are encouraged to apply. What You Can Expect Hands-on exposure to B2B industrial sales . Opportunity to work with manufacturing companies and industrial customers. Learning about technical products, applications, and solution selling . Exposure to the complete sales cycle from lead generation to order execution and commissioning . Opportunity to develop strong skills in sales, business development, negotiation, and customer relationship management . A growth-oriented environment where initiative and learning are valued. Location Delhi/NCR Apply If you are energetic, curious, willing to learn, and want to build a career in industrial B2B sales , we would love to hear from you.

title: Sales Development Representative -  Manager
description:
Job description Sales Development Representative Manager Location: Sector 142, Noida(Full Onsite Role) Fixed Shift : 3:30 PM - 12:30 AM IST. Job description: 
 Role Overview We're looking for an SDR Manager to lead and develop our outbound Sales Development team out of Noida. This role owns ramping new SDRs from day one: building their outbound sequences, coaching their calls, and helping them build a repeatable pipeline-generation process. The role blends enablement, coaching, and outbound strategy. You'll train reps, review their calls, and help shape how the team prospects. 
 The Day-to-Day Design, build, and continuously refine multi-touch outbound sequences (call, email, LinkedIn) for SDRs to execute against target accounts. Own the onboarding and training curriculum for new SDR hires, including cold-call structure, objection handling, discovery questions, and tailoring messaging to the buyer instead of running one template for everyone. Review recorded and live calls regularly; give SDRs specific, actionable feedback and track improvement over time. Run coaching sessions, role-plays, and call breakdowns, both individually and as a team. Partner with SDRs on account research and outreach planning, and make sure handoffs to Account Executives are clean so prospects get a smooth experience from first touch through demo. Set, monitor, and course-correct SDR activity and pipeline metrics, including calls, emails, meetings booked, SQLs, and pipeline contribution, against monthly targets. Work with Marketing to translate campaigns, events, and content into outbound talk tracks, and feed field intelligence (objections, positioning gaps, competitor mentions) back to Marketing and Sales leadership. Keep HubSpot cadences, sequences, and reporting accurate and up to date so pipeline data reflects reality. Identify what's working and what isn't across the team's outbound motion, and adjust strategy accordingly. 
 Preferred Candidate Profile 4-7 years in sales development, inside sales, or SDR leadership, with direct experience managing or mentoring SDRs. Experience selling into the North American market. A track record of building and running outbound sequences that convert: sequences you've actually shipped and iterated on, not just studied. Strong call-coaching ability: you can listen to a call and quickly identify what to fix and how to say it constructively. A strong communicator and writer yourself, able to demonstrate the calls and emails you're asking your team to make. Data-driven: you track team and individual metrics and use them to diagnose problems, not just report numbers. Organized and process-oriented enough to run a training cadence and keep it consistent as the team grows. Comfortable working remotely and managing a distributed or hybrid team's day-to-day. Bonus: hands-on HubSpot expertise (sequences, workflows, reporting). Bonus: background in HR tech, payroll, benefits, or SaaS sales. 
 Perks, Benefits, and Other Details Work schedule: Monday to Friday Shift: 3:30 PM to 12:30 AM IST Competitive compensation based on experience. Paid time off: earned, casual, and sick days. Public holidays and festival leaves. Modern equipment (laptop and necessary tools). Learning and development opportunities. Employee referral program. Collaborative, fast-paced, and iterative startup culture.

title: Business Development Executive
description:
Open conversations with businesses abroad that need cloud, custom software or managed engineering - and turn them into qualified opportunities. This is the front of our pipeline. You find companies that plausibly need what we do, reach out with something worth reading, and get a first meeting booked. Most of our market is outside India, so the work runs across time zones and is largely written. We do not run a volume-dial operation. Sending a thousand identical emails is easy and it does not work in this market - the buyers are technical, they have seen every template, and a generic pitch gets you filtered. Researching twenty accounts properly and writing twenty specific messages does work, and that is the job. You will be given the ICP, the case studies, and access to the engineers who can answer a technical question on a call. What you bring is persistence and the judgement to tell a real opportunity from a polite conversation. Responsibilities Research and build target account lists that match our ideal customer profile Run outbound across email, LinkedIn and calls, with messaging written for each account rather than blasted Qualify inbound enquiries from the website and route them properly Book and prepare discovery calls for senior team members, with a written brief on the account beforehand Keep the CRM accurate - stage, next step, and honest notes; a clean pipeline is part of the role, not admin around it Follow up systematically on opportunities that go quiet Work with marketing so that campaigns and outbound target the same accounts Report weekly on activity, meetings booked and pipeline created Requirements 1-5 years in business development, inside sales or lead generation - ideally B2B services or technology Genuinely strong written English; you will be writing to decision-makers in the US, UK and Europe Comfortable on the phone and on video calls with people more senior than you Able to research an account and form a point of view about why they would care Organised - you can hold fifty live conversations without losing track of any of them Willing to work hours that overlap with international clients when a call requires it Benefits Direct ownership of your area - no layer of management between you and the outcome Work on accounts and products that ship to international clients A senior team that will review your work properly and tell you what is wrong with it Budget for the tools and certifications the role genuinely needs Five-day week, on-site in Noida ","

title: Sales Executive - Software & SaaS
description:
Carry deals from first call to signature for our custom development work and our SaaS products for local businesses. Where business development opens the door, this role walks through it. You run discovery, shape the proposal with our engineers, handle procurement and negotiation, and close. Two things are being sold. One is custom software and cloud engineering, where the deal is consultative, the buyer is often technical, and the proposal has to survive scrutiny from someone who will have to maintain what we build. The other is our own SaaS products for legal, real estate, HVAC and similar businesses - shorter cycles, demo-led, higher volume. You will need to be credible in both. That does not mean writing code; it means being able to sit on a call with a CTO, understand the constraint they are describing, and know when to bring an engineer in rather than improvise an answer. We would much rather lose a deal than win one on a promise delivery cannot keep. Responsibilities Run discovery calls that surface the real problem, the budget and the decision process Deliver product demos of our SaaS tools, tailored to the prospects industry Build proposals and scopes of work with input from engineering and delivery Handle pricing conversations, negotiation and procurement or security questionnaires Manage your pipeline in the CRM with accurate stages and realistic close dates Forecast monthly, and be honest when a deal is slipping Hand won accounts to delivery with a proper written handover, then stay involved through onboarding Feed what you hear in the market back to the product and marketing teams Requirements 2-5 years closing B2B deals in software development services, SaaS or IT services A track record you can talk through specifically - deal sizes, cycle length, what you closed and what you lost Able to run a discovery call that gets past surface requirements to the actual constraint Comfortable presenting to founders, operations heads and technical buyers Disciplined with CRM hygiene and forecasting Excellent spoken and written English; most clients are outside India Benefits Direct ownership of your area - no layer of management between you and the outcome Work on accounts and products that ship to international clients A senior team that will review your work properly and tell you what is wrong with it Budget for the tools and certifications the role genuinely needs Five-day week, on-site in Noida ","

title: Business Development Executive
description:
Open conversations with businesses abroad that need cloud, custom software or managed engineering - and turn them into qualified opportunities. This is the front of our pipeline. You find companies that plausibly need what we do, reach out with something worth reading, and get a first meeting booked. Most of our market is outside India, so the work runs across time zones and is largely written. We do not run a volume-dial operation. Sending a thousand identical emails is easy and it does not work in this market - the buyers are technical, they have seen every template, and a generic pitch gets you filtered. Researching twenty accounts properly and writing twenty specific messages does work, and that is the job. You will be given the ICP, the case studies, and access to the engineers who can answer a technical question on a call. What you bring is persistence and the judgement to tell a real opportunity from a polite conversation. Responsibilities Research and build target account lists that match our ideal customer profile Run outbound across email, LinkedIn and calls, with messaging written for each account rather than blasted Qualify inbound enquiries from the website and route them properly Book and prepare discovery calls for senior team members, with a written brief on the account beforehand Keep the CRM accurate - stage, next step, and honest notes; a clean pipeline is part of the role, not admin around it Follow up systematically on opportunities that go quiet Work with marketing so that campaigns and outbound target the same accounts Report weekly on activity, meetings booked and pipeline created Requirements 1-5 years in business development, inside sales or lead generation - ideally B2B services or technology Genuinely strong written English; you will be writing to decision-makers in the US, UK and Europe Comfortable on the phone and on video calls with people more senior than you Able to research an account and form a point of view about why they would care Organised - you can hold fifty live conversations without losing track of any of them Willing to work hours that overlap with international clients when a call requires it Benefits Direct ownership of your area - no layer of management between you and the outcome Work on accounts and products that ship to international clients A senior team that will review your work properly and tell you what is wrong with it Budget for the tools and certifications the role genuinely needs Five-day week, on-site in Noida ","

title: Sales Executive - Software & SaaS
description:
Carry deals from first call to signature for our custom development work and our SaaS products for local businesses. Where business development opens the door, this role walks through it. You run discovery, shape the proposal with our engineers, handle procurement and negotiation, and close. Two things are being sold. One is custom software and cloud engineering, where the deal is consultative, the buyer is often technical, and the proposal has to survive scrutiny from someone who will have to maintain what we build. The other is our own SaaS products for legal, real estate, HVAC and similar businesses - shorter cycles, demo-led, higher volume. You will need to be credible in both. That does not mean writing code; it means being able to sit on a call with a CTO, understand the constraint they are describing, and know when to bring an engineer in rather than improvise an answer. We would much rather lose a deal than win one on a promise delivery cannot keep. Responsibilities Run discovery calls that surface the real problem, the budget and the decision process Deliver product demos of our SaaS tools, tailored to the prospects industry Build proposals and scopes of work with input from engineering and delivery Handle pricing conversations, negotiation and procurement or security questionnaires Manage your pipeline in the CRM with accurate stages and realistic close dates Forecast monthly, and be honest when a deal is slipping Hand won accounts to delivery with a proper written handover, then stay involved through onboarding Feed what you hear in the market back to the product and marketing teams Requirements 2-5 years closing B2B deals in software development services, SaaS or IT services A track record you can talk through specifically - deal sizes, cycle length, what you closed and what you lost Able to run a discovery call that gets past surface requirements to the actual constraint Comfortable presenting to founders, operations heads and technical buyers Disciplined with CRM hygiene and forecasting Excellent spoken and written English; most clients are outside India Benefits Direct ownership of your area - no layer of management between you and the outcome Work on accounts and products that ship to international clients A senior team that will review your work properly and tell you what is wrong with it Budget for the tools and certifications the role genuinely needs Five-day week, on-site in Noida ","

description:
Misha Infotech is a leading IT consulting and technology services company headquartered in Noida. We deliver end-to-end IT solutions including Web & Mobile Application Development, IT Infrastructure, Cybersecurity, AV Solutions, and Resource Outsourcing. With a strong presence in the government and PSU ecosystem, we help organizations leverage technology to achieve efficiency, scalability, and digital transformation. 
 Role Summary We are looking for an experienced Senior Sales Manager / Senior BDM Government Vertical to drive PAN-India sales across Central & State Government departments, PSUs, and Nodal Agencies. The role demands deep expertise in GeM Portal sales, government procurement cycles, budgeting, tendering, and liaisoning with government officials, along with the ability to build alliances and close large government deals. 
 Key Responsibilities Manage end-to-end sales operations for Central & State Government accounts across India. Drive business primarily through the Government e-Marketplace (GeM) Portal, including: Bid participation, BOQ and QCBS bidding Reverse auctions, direct purchase, and order management Compliance, SLA, penalties, and post-order execution coordination Maintain strong liaisoning with government officers, PSU officials, and procurement authorities to generate and convert opportunities. Understand and align sales strategy with government procurement cycles, budgeting timelines, and fund availability. Work closely with PSUs and Nodal Agencies for: Empanelment and onboarding Routing government business through PSU frameworks Assist customers in RFP, RFQ, EOI, and tender specification creation. Identify, build, and manage strategic alliances with PSUs, System Integrators (SIs), and local partners to crack large deals. Build and manage a strong pipeline of qualified government opportunities. Lead large government bids end-to-end, including bid strategy, pricing, compliance, and coordination with internal teams. Strategically position company offerings to influence product specifications and enhance competitiveness in tenders. Conduct market and competitor analysis to identify opportunities and tender gaps. Deliver impactful presentations, demos, and solution walkthroughs to government stakeholders. Ensure strong account management to drive repeat business, renewals, cross-sell, and upsell. Lead, mentor, and manage the government sales team to achieve revenue targets. 
 Qualifications & Experience MBA and/or Engineering degree with specialization in Sales & Marketing from a reputed institution. 57 years of overall experience in IT sales. Minimum 4–5 years of proven experience in selling software solutions / IT services to Government & PSU clients. Hands-on experience working with Central and State Government departments, PSUs, and Nodal Agencies such as MeitY, NIC, CSIR, etc. Strong experience in large government deal bidding and closures. 
 Key Skills & Competencies Strong hands-on expertise with GeM Portal (buyer & seller perspective). Deep understanding of government procurement processes and budgeting cycles. Proven liaisoning skills with government officers and PSU stakeholders. Extensive experience in tendering (L1, QCBS, open & limited tenders). Strong knowledge of tender documentation, compliance, and bid evaluation. Experience working with PSUs for empanelment and business routing. Ability to collaborate with System Integrators and partners on complex government deals. Excellent negotiation, presentation, and relationship-building skills. Strategic thinker with strong execution capability in the government sales ecosystem. 
 Desired Candidate Profile Must have extensive GeM-based sales experience. Strong network within government departments and PSUs. Ability to provide nationwide sales support and manage multiple government accounts. Strong analytical skills to identify competitor weaknesses in bidding and tendering. Self-driven, result-oriented, and capable of independently managing large government accounts. CANDIDATE MUST BE FROM DELHI/NCR ONLY 
 Location Noida

description:

 Location: Noida

 Industry: IT Solutions & Services About ATAOP ATAOP (OPC) Private Limited is a professionally managed IT solutions company providing end-to-end technology services to businesses across multiple industries. We design, implement and manage secure, scalable and performance-driven IT environments based on our clients operational and business requirements. Our key solution areas include: IT Infrastructure & Complete Office IT Setup Server Deployment, Virtualization & Management Cloud & Private Cloud Solutions Networking, Firewall & Cybersecurity Solutions Managed IT Services and AMC Support DocSuite Private Cloud File Collaboration & Document Management ERP, HRMS & CRM Solutions Web Application & Website Development Server, Storage and Backup Solutions Enterprise IT Consulting and Technology Implementation We have a strong technical delivery capability and are looking for an experienced Business Development Manager who can help expand our B2B client base and drive new business growth. Role Overview We are looking for a results-driven Business Development Manager IT Solutions & Services who can independently identify opportunities, acquire new corporate clients and manage the complete B2B sales cycle. This is a hands-on business development and revenue-generation role . The candidate will be responsible not only for generating leads but also for conducting client meetings, understanding technical requirements, coordinating with the technical team, preparing proposals, negotiating commercials and closing business. The role will initially operate as an individual contributor with significant ownership of new business acquisition and the opportunity to contribute to the future growth of the sales function. Key Responsibilities Identify and acquire new B2B clients for ATAOP's IT solutions and services. Develop a strong pipeline of qualified corporate prospects and business opportunities. Generate leads through LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo.io, cold calling, email outreach, referrals, networking, industry contacts and other relevant channels. Identify and connect with business decision-makers including Founders, CXOs, CIOs, CTOs, IT Heads, Admin Heads and Procurement teams. Conduct client meetings to understand existing IT infrastructure, operational challenges, business requirements and upcoming technology needs. Work closely with the technical team to design appropriate solutions based on client requirements. Present ATAOP's IT solutions, capabilities and service offerings to prospective clients. Prepare business proposals, presentations, quotations, commercial offers, RFQs/RFPs and other sales documentation. Manage the complete sales cycle from prospecting and qualification through proposal, negotiation and deal closure. Conduct regular follow-ups with prospects and maintain momentum throughout the sales cycle. Negotiate commercials, service terms and project scope while protecting business margins. Develop relationships with corporate clients to generate repeat business, renewals, cross-selling and upselling opportunities. Maintain all leads, opportunities, meetings, follow-ups and sales activities accurately in CRM. Maintain an updated sales pipeline and provide regular revenue forecasts and business-development reports. Track competitors, market trends and emerging business opportunities within the IT solutions industry. Coordinate with technical, project and support teams for effective customer handover after deal closure. Attend customer meetings and business-development activities across Delhi NCR and travel when required. Consistently achieve monthly, quarterly and annual business-development and revenue targets. Required Experience & Skills 37 years of experience in Business Development, IT Sales, Enterprise Sales or B2B Technology Sales. Minimum 3 years of relevant experience selling IT solutions or technology services to corporate clients. Proven experience in generating new clients rather than only managing existing accounts. Demonstrated ability to independently manage the complete sales cycle and close business. Experience selling one or more of the following will be highly preferred: IT Infrastructure Servers & Storage Networking Firewall & Cybersecurity Cloud / Private Cloud Virtualization Managed IT Services / AMC ERP / HRMS / CRM Software or Web Application Development Enterprise Technology Solutions Strong understanding of consultative and solution-based B2B selling. Experience with cold calling, LinkedIn prospecting, email outreach and corporate lead generation. Experience using LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo.io or similar B2B prospecting platforms will be an advantage. Experience working with CRM platforms and maintaining a structured sales pipeline. Strong presentation, communication, negotiation and client-handling abilities. Ability to communicate effectively with both business decision-makers and technical stakeholders. Strong follow-up discipline and target-oriented approach. Good written and verbal communication skills in English and Hindi. Ability to work independently and take ownership of revenue targets. Preferred Candidate We would particularly like to meet candidates who have worked with an IT System Integrator, IT Infrastructure Company, Managed Service Provider, Cloud Solution Provider, Software/ERP Company, Cybersecurity Company or B2B Technology Services organization. Candidates who already have experience engaging with corporate IT Heads, CIOs, CTOs, Procurement teams, Founders and senior management will be preferred. Existing corporate relationships within Delhi NCR will be an added advantage. What We Are Looking For We are looking for someone who is comfortable creating business, not waiting for incoming leads . The successful candidate should be capable of building his/her own pipeline, securing meetings, understanding client requirements, developing opportunities and taking ownership until commercial closure. This is not a pure telecalling, lead-generation or digital-marketing position. It is a complete B2B IT business-development and sales role. What ATAOP Offers Opportunity to sell a broad portfolio of enterprise IT solutions and services. Strong technical team support during solution design and client discussions. Exposure to infrastructure, servers, cloud, security, managed services and software solutions. Direct involvement in business growth and strategic client acquisition. Performance-linked incentives in addition to fixed compensation. Opportunity to grow with the organization and play a key role in developing ATAOP's sales function. Compensation: 4–5.5 LPA + Performance-Based Incentives, depending on experience, existing capabilities and proven sales performance. Job Location: Noida Candidates with proven experience in B2B IT Sales, IT Solutions Sales, Corporate Client Acquisition and Deal Closure are encouraged to apply.
